total_model.summary: Model projects 42.6 total points (JAX 24, HOU 19). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.3), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.2), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
